verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Letta publishes an llms.txt at docs.letta.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with structured front matter covering cloud/local backends and web/desktop/CLI/SDK interfaces. Every documentation page in the pack is also served as a markdown index.md, which is agent-consumable docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining how to point agents at llms.txt or the markdown docs, and evidence of a full-content variant or per-section coverage beyond the header.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
